name: io.github.TKMD/reftrixmcp
description: Web design analysis with 39 MCP tools: layout, motion, quality, semantic search via pgvector

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string with pgvector extension

environmentVariables.name: REDIS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Redis/Valkey connection URL for BullMQ job queue. Required for page.analyze async processing and rate limiting. Falls back to in-memory when unavailable

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama API base URL for Vision LLM integration (default: http://localhost:11434)

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Ollama API endpoint for vision analysis
